caption: The drawing consists of three rectangular labels arranged in a loose stack near the center of a cream-colored background. The uppermost rectangle depicts an outdoor scene with two children: one girl wearing a tan dress with red accents and blue stockings is giving another child, dressed in green, a piggyback ride. Both children have light-colored hair. To the left, a small brown dog is running, and the background includes leafless trees and some green foliage. The words "A HAPPY NEW YEAR" are inscribed at the bottom of this image. Below this rectangle are two more partial rectangles, both bordered in brown and edged in pink. The top of these rectangles reads "H. HINWARD & SONS" in black text with a decorative flourish. The lower rectangle displays the words "Numerical Needle Case" in a white oval bordered by a vine motif. Above it are black numbers from 6 to 9 alongside small hooks or tabs. The objects are arranged against a plain background, with the words "ACTUAL SIZE" faintly written at the top right corner of the page.
title: Needle Case
